scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:web & pnpm run dev:api
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @nextcommerce/web lint && pnpm --filter @nextcommerce/api lint && pnpm --filter @nextcommerce/shared lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @nextcommerce/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @nextcommerce/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @nextcommerce/shared typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @nextcommerce/web test && pnpm --filter @nextcommerce/api test && pnpm --filter @nextcommerce/shared test
